mechanics.name: Wrath of Ragnaros
mechanics.note: Goes off in a ring twenty yards round him and throws whoever it catches back, into the lava if they were standing where he could throw them there.

mechanics.name: Lava Burst
mechanics.note: Bursts out around him, and Forever hits harder with it than vanilla did at both raid sizes; being in the ring at all is the mistake.

mechanics.name: Elemental Fire
mechanics.note: The burn he puts on whoever he is hitting. Tank damage.

mechanics.name: Magma Blast
mechanics.note: He only throws it when nobody is in melee range. A Magma Blast in the log means the melee were out of position, not that the target was.
